description: This file defines the TextNode class for a tree widget, representing a text node in a tree structure with methods for rendering and interaction.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.TextNode
classes.description: Represents a text node within the tree widget, with properties and methods for label setup and HTML rendering.

methods.name: setUpLabel(oData)
methods.description: Initializes the label, href, target, and label element ID for the node based on provided data.

methods.name: getLabelEl()
methods.description: Returns the DOM element corresponding to the label of this node.

methods.name: getNodeHtml()
methods.description: Generates the HTML string representing this node for rendering within the tree view.
